description: Defines a generic class TopicData that manages a set of subscriber references and associated hashes for a topic in a pub/sub system.

classes.name: TopicData
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, final class representing a set of subscribers and their associated hashes for a specific topic.

methods.name: firstSubscriber
methods.description: Creates a new TopicData instance with the first subscriber and associated hashes.

methods.name: addSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to the set of subscribers.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the set of subscribers.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subscribers.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Returns the hashes associated with the topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Provides a stream of current subscribers.

methods.name: exportSubscribers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable copy of the subscribers set.
